ARM_A_BASELINE.description: Baseline RAG + Groq Real LLM (Trust Control DISABLED, Abstention DEFAULT, Claim Verification DISABLED)

ARM_B_ADAPTIVE.description: Adaptive Trust-Aware RAG + Groq Real LLM (Trust Control ENABLED, Abstention ENABLED, Claim Verification ENABLED)

metrics.claim_support_rate: Proportion of generated factual claims that are successfully verified against the cited retrieved evidence. NOT a measure of medical answer correctness.
metrics.citation_validation_rate: Proportion of generated citations that map to valid retrieved chunks.
metrics.unsupported_answer_rate: Proportion of answers containing at least one UNSUPPORTED_OR_UNVERIFIED_CLAIM.
metrics.abstention_rate: OBSERVED_ABSTENTION_RATE. (Abstention correctness cannot be evaluated without expected-abstention ground truth).
metrics.provider_failure_rate: Provider failures / total authorized provider requests.

failure_policy: Provider failures are explicitly recorded. No retries, no imputation, no fallback.
abstention_policy: Controlled abstentions are recorded. Excluded from claim support rates.
reproducibility_statement: seed=NOT_SUPPORTED. Strict deterministic replay is FALSE.
